description: The agent's only way to a model. Checks the caller, keeps a token budget per lease and sends the conversation to the model provider with its own key, never the agent's headers. The only component that holds a model key (Anthropic: a secret file). No database. As shipped (the scripted backend) it calls nobody; with the Anthropic backend it also reaches that provider, and the cluster allows the provider's host name for this pod only.
